'''Hal Moir''' is one of [[Gawyn Trakand]]s [[Younglings]].

== Activities ==
He is with Gawyn when they are sent to act as escort for a group of [[Aes Sedai]] that make an alliance with the [[Shaido]].

He survives [[Dumai's Wells]] and retreats to the village of [[Dorlan]].
